Every capture angle showing two rails + end fin stacks with no face was therefore correct geometry. Product fiction calls these 'radiator plates' (src/data/wreckAftermathDressing.js, src/data/wreckCourt/places.js, src/data/encounters/capital-boss/furnace-maw.js), so this was a real construction gap, not a slat-frame-by-design choice. Rebuilt source GLB via Blender 5.1 (--only aftermath; only aft_radiator_panel.glb content changed among aftermath sources; foreign frag_grating_sheet churn preserved). Updated the aft_radiator_panel record in assets/incubator/wreck_aftermath_pack/evidence/build-report.json (285212->331840 bytes, new sha256) so the release identity check accepts the intentional source change, then ran build-pack-release-assets.mjs --only=place_aftermath_aft_radiator_panel (release 176.7 KiB, manifest updated transactionally), refresh-render-package-pilots.mjs --only=..., and build-render-package-pilots.mjs --only=...
